title: Custom Fiery Soccer Ball, Custom Name Comforter Set, Machin - Design 5
description:
Inspire your young athlete with this Jeminise Soccer Player Comforter Set, designed to bring the excitement of the game into any boy's room. This custom bedding set allows for personalization with a name and number, making it a unique and cherished item for any soccer fan.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Ideal for young soccer enthusiasts, inspiring them to chase their dreams and celebrate their love for the sport.
  • Personalized Design: Customize with a name and number to create a unique and special bedding set.
  • Easy to Use: Features a hidden zipper and a smooth metal pull for effortless duvet insertion and removal.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Environmentally friendly finishing process ensures fabric retains dye and prevents fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching for lasting enjoyment.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water and can be air-dried without heat, ensuring quick drying and fluffier results.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover, with 2 pillowcases and 2 shams (quantity subject to size).

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polycotton
Fabric Type Polycotton
Pattern Soccer
Selected Design A4
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 1 text input
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Selected Size Full
Pillowcase Length 20 inches
Pillowcase Width 20 inches
Pillowcase Quantity 2
Sham Quantity 2
Style Modern
Thread Count 360
Care Instructions Machine Wash
